title: Input
description: A single-line text input with sizes, variants, prefix / suffix content, a clear button, a character count and a password visibility toggle. Wrap it in a FormField for a label, helper text and error message.

props.name: value
props.description: Text of the field (controlled)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text (uncontrolled)

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `outline` (bordered), `filled` (tinted background) or `unstyled` (no frame)

props.name: size
props.description: Height (`--control-height-*`) and font size

props.name: invalid
props.description: Error state: danger border (`aria-invalid` on the web)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and selectable, but the text cannot be edited

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the text, e.g. an icon or "@"

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content after the text, e.g. a unit or a button

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value (not when disabled or read-only). Clearing calls `onChange("")` and `onClear`

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the clear button

props.name: type
props.description: `password` hides the text and shows a visibility toggle

props.name: showPasswordLabel
props.description: Label of the visibility toggle while hidden

props.name: hidePasswordLabel
props.description: Label of the visibility toggle while visible

props.name: showCharCount
props.description: Shows the number of characters (and `maxLength`, when set) after the text

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field; a string label is also the field's accessible name (unless `accessibilityLabel` is set)

props.name: wrapperStyle
props.description: Style of the frame around the text

props.name: inputStyle
props.description: Style of the TextInput

events.name: onChange
events.description: Called with the new text on every edit and when the field is cleared

events.name: onClear
events.description: Called after the clear button emptied the field

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Native input attributes and events pass through; className styles the wrapper and ref reaches the <input>.

examples.title: Clear button and character count
examples.description: clearable shows a labelled clear button while the field has a value; clearing fires onChange with an empty value and keeps focus in the field. showCharCount shows the length (and maxLength) and links it to the input.

examples.title: Sizes and variants
examples.description: Three sizes and the outline, filled and unstyled variants.

examples.title: States
examples.description: invalid, disabled and readOnly; inside a FormField the state is inherited. Read-only fields use --readonly-surface-color, keep normal text contrast and remain focusable for selecting and copying. They do not show editing affordances; invalid borders remain visible.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Validate on submit and show the message with the FormField errorMessage: the input becomes invalid and is described by the message.

InputProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl); sets aria-invalid
InputProps.prefix: Content before the text, e.g. an icon or "@"
InputProps.suffix: Content after the text, e.g. a unit, an icon or a button
InputProps.className: Class name of the outer wrapper (not the <input>)
InputProps.clearable: Shows a clear button while the field has a value (not when disabled or read-only); clearing fires onChange with an empty value
InputProps.onClear: Called after the clear button emptied the field
InputProps.clearLabel: Accessible label of the clear button (defaults to a localized "Clear")
InputProps.showCharCount: Shows the number of characters (and maxLength, when set), linked to the input with aria-describedby
InputProps.showPasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is hidden
InputProps.hidePasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is visible

cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the field (every size; defaults to the density's control height of the size)
cssVars.--input-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the text (every size)
cssVars.--input-background: Background color of the outline variant

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Uncontrolled input and an input whose owner synchronizes its value property from minerva-input. Both can be edited and cleared.

sizes-variants.title: Sizes, variants and states
sizes-variants.description: Three sizes, the outline, filled and unstyled variants, and the read-only, disabled and invalid states.

addons.title: Addons, clear, count and password
addons.description: prefix and suffix slots, a clear button (clearable), a character count bound to maxlength, and the password visibility toggle.

form.title: In a form
form.description: required, type="email", minlength and pattern use the browser's validation on submit; the failed fields get invalid until they are fixed, and reset restores them.

props.defaultValue: Initial value (the value attribute), restored by form.reset(). Like <input>, changing it also changes value until the user edits the field.
props.type: Type of the inner <input> (text, email, password, search, url, number, date…).
props.placeholder: Placeholder text shown while the field is empty.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but not editable.
props.minLength: Minimum length of the value (validated by the browser).
props.maxLength: Maximum length of the value; also the limit of the character count.
props.pattern: Regular expression the value must match.
props.name: Name under which the value is submitted with the form.
props.disabled: Disables the control: not focusable, not submitted, not validated.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.value: Current value (property; the value attribute sets defaultValue).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The value was committed (blur or Enter), re-dispatched from the inner input.
events.input: The value changed (each keystroke; native, composed).
events.minerva-input: Same as input, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-change: Same as change, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-clear: The clear button emptied the field.

slots.suffix: Content after the text (unit, icon, button).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).

states.title: States
